dish.title: Cantonese Char Siu Pork with Rice and Blanched Gai Lan
dish.description: Strips of pork shoulder marinated in hoisin, soy sauce, Shaoxing wine, five-spice, garlic, and honey, roasted on a rack and basted until lacquered and charred at the edges. Sliced over steamed rice with blanched gai lan and a drizzle of the reduced glaze.

recipe_version.title: Cantonese Char Siu Pork with Rice and Blanched Gai Lan
recipe_version.description: Strips of pork shoulder marinated in hoisin, soy sauce, Shaoxing wine, five-spice, garlic, and honey, roasted on a rack and basted until lacquered and charred at the edges. Sliced over steamed rice with blanched gai lan and a drizzle of the reduced glaze.

ingredients.name: boneless pork shoulder
ingredients.preparation: cut with the grain into strips about 2 inches thick

ingredients.name: hoisin sauce
ingredients.display_name: hoisin sauce whose label lists sugar, soybeans, wheat, vinegar, sesame, garlic, and chile, with no shellfish

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.note: for the pan under the rack

steps.title: Marinate
steps.body: Whisk the hoisin, 2 tbsp soy sauce, Shaoxing wine, 3 tbsp honey, five-spice, garlic, and sesame oil. Put the pork strips and marinade in a gallon zip-top bag and massage to coat.

steps.title: Rest in the marinade
steps.body: Refrigerate 2 hours (up to overnight), turning once. Rinse the rice and trim the gai lan meanwhile.

steps.title: Preheat and make the glaze
steps.body: Preheat the oven to 425 F. Lift the pork onto a wire rack set over a rimmed sheet pan and pour 2 cups water into the pan. Boil the leftover marinade with 1 tbsp honey in a 1-quart saucepan for 5 minutes until syrupy.

steps.title: Roast
steps.body: Roast the pork 15 minutes, turn and brush with glaze, and roast 10 minutes more. Brush again and roast until lacquered, charred at the edges, and 160 F, about 8 minutes. Rest 5 minutes.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.body: When the pork goes in, combine the rice and 2 1/2 cups water in a 2-quart saucepan, bring to a boil over high heat, cover, turn to low, and cook 15 minutes; rest covered 10 minutes. This runs inside step 4 (overlap stated).

steps.title: Blanch the gai lan
steps.body: While the pork rests, bring 8 cups water and 1 tsp salt to a boil in a 4-quart pot (start it during the last roast), blanch the gai lan 2 minutes, drain, and drizzle with the oil and 1 tbsp soy sauce (overlap stated).

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Slice the char siu thin and fan it over the rice with the gai lan alongside. Drizzle with the remaining glaze.

equipment: rimmed sheet pan with wire rack
